استيمنت (form X)
# اِسْتَيْمَنْتُ (istaymantu) /is.taj.man.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَيْمَنَ (istaymana)
# اِسْتَيْمَنْتَ (istaymanta) /is.taj.man.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَيْمَنَ (istaymana)
# اِسْتَيْمَنْتِ (istaymanti) /is.taj.man.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَيْمَنَ (istaymana)
# اِسْتَيْمَنَتْ (istaymanat) /is.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
